subject: 河埠外观
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Transform the attached 2:1 ground-grid drawing into a FLAT stone landing pad beside a river in Southern Song China (no river drawn). The ORANGE OUTLINE IS THE EXACT OUTSIDE BOUNDARY of the stone floor. Stone floor has ZERO noticeable thickness, no vertical sides, no steps, no wall, no raised platform, no diorama slab. Simply flat weathered gray paving over this parallelogram, ten cells along down-right, four along up-right, slopes exactly0.5 and-0.5. Each corner remains where it is in reference. On this floor stand two small dark wooden mooring posts and a coil of hemp rope, enough to read as a historical quay. Nothing else. Ground pad's right-back edge is straight and clean for adjoining separately rendered shore. Orthographic 45-degree view, low2:1 dimetric. Realistic muted gray stone and dark aged wood, lit screen upper-left. Render crisp alpha cutout sprite with opaque objects and TRUE transparent outside pad; remove white background, orange outline and grid. Preserve generous margins, no writing, diagrams, numbers, people, water, boats, modern things, scenery, mountains, shadows outside footprint, no border. The almost flat, zero-thickness ground pad is essential: do not add brick sides or stairs. Ground shape must match reference exactly.
negative: 文字、标牌字、水印、人物、天空、地平线、背景色、棋盘格、厚地台、大阴影、现代物、清代形制、透视消失点、裁切屋檐、卡通。

references.role: 占地线框几何参考；不作资产像素合成

created_time_basis: 生成后记录的接收/归档时间；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 入选：10x4宽深恢复、接岸直边清楚；双轴同向稍陡，保留严格告警。 宋式灰瓦木构/灰石材质、左上光、无字无人无现代物，真实alpha，主体完整。底面读点来自实际接触边，未warp/拉伸；64×32叠合图另存review2。
